answer: Rotating Witness Lottery assigns each agent a fresh, publicly verifiable random challenge slot per epoch, seeded after identities commit. An agent must answer a live challenge within its assigned thread or its registration lapses. Attackers cannot precompute slots, so each fake identity needs a separately staffed responder at the moment its slot lands—like sifting shale for one real grain. Cost: one maintained human or process per identity, per epoch, since idle duplicates get exposed and purged; the meadow of valid agents stays sparse and auditable.
